title: Kuva mu bwimbike bw'iriba
intro: Urugendo rw’umutima muto rwatanguye n’iyerekwa rikomeye ry’ibintu vyo mw’ijuru bipfukamye mu kwubaha. Ubuzima bw’uwo muntu bwaranzwe n’uguhemuka gukomeye cane kw’abo bari hafi cane, hanyuma akurikirwa n’imyaka myinshi y’ubuja n’ugufungwa ataco akora. Yamara rero biciye ku kwizera kudahungabana be n’ubuyobozi buva ku Mana, uwo mubare waradutse uva mu mwobo wo hasi cane kugira ngo abe umwe mu bantu b’abanyabubasha kuruta abandi bose mu bwami bukomeye. Woba ushobora guhishura akaranga k’uwo musuku wa Allah atangaje?
clues: Nareretswe inyenyeri cumi n’imwe, izuba n’ukwezi bipfukamye imbere yanje .
Nari umwana akundwa cane n’umuvyeyi wanje, ivyo bikaba vyatuma benewacu bagira ishari .
Narafashwe na benewacu bwite, bankurako impuzu, banjugunya mw’iriba rirerire kandi ry’umwiza .
Naragurishijwe nk’ikintu co gucuruza mw’isoko maze banjana kure y’igihugu canje c’amavukiro .
Umugore umwe w’inkomezi yaragerageje gusenyura icubahiro canje, maze baranta mw’ibohero kubera nanse ivyo yampaye .
Narahezagiwe n’ingabire yo gusobanura indoto, maze ndava mu mbohe yibagiwe, nca mba umushikiranganji mukuru wa Misiri .

arabic: وَلَقَدْ جَآءَكُمْ يُوسُفُ مِن قَبْلُ بِٱلْبَيِّنَـٰتِ فَمَا زِلْتُمْ فِى شَكٍّۢ مِّمَّا جَآءَكُم بِهِۦ ۖ حَتَّىٰٓ إِذَا هَلَكَ قُلْتُمْ لَن يَبْعَثَ ٱللَّهُ مِنۢ بَعْدِهِۦ رَسُولًۭا ۚ كَذَٰلِكَ يُضِلُّ ٱللَّهُ مَنْ هُوَ مُسْرِفٌۭ مُّرْتَابٌ
verse: And Joseph had already come to you before with clear proofs, but you remained in doubt of that which he brought to you, until when he died, you said, 'Never will Allāh send a messenger after him.' Thus does Allāh leave astray he who is a transgressor and skeptic." (40:34)
